description: This file defines a SessionManager class responsible for managing user authentication sessions, including login, logout, token refresh, and persistence using Keychain. It handles session restoration, token validity checks, and integration with an authentication API.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A final class conforming to ObservableObject, managing user authentication session state, including tokens, session restoration, login, logout, and token refresh logic.

methods.name: restoreFromKeychainIfPossible
methods.description: Restores tokens from Keychain and sets session as authenticated if valid; attempts token refresh if expired.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, and persists tokens securely.

methods.name: authorizedRequestToken
methods.description: Returns a valid access token, refreshing it if necessary; throws if not authenticated.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, invalidates the session, and clears Keychain.

methods.name: refreshIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes the access token if expired or near expiry.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies new token data to the session's stored properties.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears session data both in Keychain and in-memory properties.
